westlake.name: West Lake
westlake.price_text: Free · some gardens charge a small fee
westlake.hours: Open all day · best in daylight
westlake.tip: Walk the Su Causeway early morning before crowds and heat arrive.
westlake.best: Early morning or late afternoon; spring and autumn

lingyin.name: Lingyin Temple
lingyin.price_text: ≈ CNY 45 Feilai Feng scenic area + ≈ CNY 30 temple entry; check on the day
lingyin.tip: Buy the scenic-area ticket first, then the temple ticket inside. Go at opening for quiet halls.

leifeng.name: Leifeng Pagoda
leifeng.tip: Ride the escalators up and take the top-floor view over the lake at sunset.

boatride.name: West Lake Boat Ride
boatride.price_text: ≈ CNY 35–70 depending on boat type; check at the pier
boatride.tip: Public ferry boats are cheaper than private cruises. Sit on the open deck.
boatride.best: Morning or near sunset on a clear day

zju.name: Zhejiang University (Yuquan campus)
zju.price_text: Free · campus access may need registration
zju.hours: Daytime · check access rules on the day
zju.tip: Campus entry rules for visitors change; ask at the gate before you plan around it.

zhongshuge.name: Zhongshuge Bookstore
zhongshuge.price_text: Free to enter · café purchases extra
zhongshuge.tip: The mirrored ceiling makes it busy; come on a weekday morning for photos.

hefang.name: Hefang Street
hefang.price_text: Free to walk · snacks from ≈ CNY 10
hefang.tip: Try local snacks like beggar's chicken and dragon-boat rice cakes. Prices rise toward the main gate.

longjing.name: Longjing tea village walk
longjing.price_text: Free to walk · tea tasting ≈ CNY 30–80
longjing.tip: Walk the lanes between tea fields, then sit for a pot of Longjing in a village tea house.

sudi.name: Su Causeway walk
sudi.tip: About 3 km end to end. Start early to avoid heat and tour groups.

wushan.name: Wushan (Wu Hill) viewpoint
wushan.tip: Short climb for a rooftop view over the old town and lake. Wear grippy shoes.

silkmarket.name: Silk market and old lanes walk
silkmarket.tip: Haggle politely and compare a few stalls before buying silk.

xixi.name: Xixi Wetland Park
xixi.price_text: ≈ CNY 80 main zone · boat extra; check on the day
xixi.tip: Large and spread out. Allow half a day and take a boat to cover more water.

canal.name: Grand Canal night walk (Gongchen Bridge)
canal.hours: Open all day · lights on in evening
canal.tip: Walk the old bridge area after dark when the canal is lit and quieter.

impression.name: Impression West Lake show
impression.price_text: ≈ CNY 200–400 by seat; check on the day
impression.tip: Outdoor stage on the water. Book ahead and bring a layer for cool evenings.

hubin.name: Hubin lakeside promenade
hubin.tip: Flat paved loop near the shops. Good for an easy evening stroll with lake views.

foodstreet.name: Local noodle and snack shops (Hubin lanes)
foodstreet.tip: Look for busy shops with local diners. Order noodles like pian'erchuan or shrimp noodles.

pagodaview.name: Baochu Pagoda hill viewpoint
pagodaview.tip: Short uphill walk for a view of the lake and pagoda. Go early to beat the heat.

teahouse.name: Lakeside tea house break
teahouse.tip: Sit by the water with a pot of Longjing tea. Prices vary a lot, so check the menu first.

bike.name: Lakeside bike loop
bike.price_text: ≈ CNY 10–30 per hour via app; check on the day
bike.tip: Shared bikes are cheap and quick. Some lakeside paths are pedestrian-only, so follow signs.

museum.name: Zhejiang Provincial Museum
museum.price_text: Free · ID may be needed to enter
museum.hours: Closed Monday · roughly 09:00–17:00; check on the day
museum.tip: Free and good for a hot or rainy afternoon. Bring ID for entry.
